basic_info.description: Located in the highly desirable San Francisco neighborhood of Pacific Heights. This is a multi-unit building that is vacant, well-maintained, and we have the new recorded CC&R's & Condo map. Each of the units are spacious and filled with natural light. Units 1836 and 1838 feature three bedrooms and two baths. Unit 1840, the penthouse unit, features two bedrooms and two baths with partial bay view. On the ground floor, there is a legal room/kitchen and bath. The backyard patio is completed and ready for outdoor gatherings. The garage has 2+ parking spaces. This is a rare opportunity to own a property in a move-in condition, prestige location near to public transportation, shops, restaurants, and parks.
